title: A Causal Framework to Measure and Mitigate Non-binary Treatment Discrimination
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not benchmark any aspect of faith/religion. It only mentions religion as a potential sensitive attribute for future extensions of its framework.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of its analysis. Religion was only mentioned in a hypothetical example to illustrate the potential for extending the proposed framework.
